taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: GraphQL authorization and execution controls — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect schema and resolver mappings for a protected node, global node lookup, nested relationship, mutation and subscription. Establish policy on the resolved object and sensitive fields.
controls.controlled_verification: Resolve private synthetic node B through the ordinary field and the global node/relationship path as actor A. Use the same B identifier and A context. For a subscription, inspect how identity and entitlement changes are applied to later events; do not assume handshake authorization covers each resource.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Introspection, aliases, batching and query depth are features. They establish a vulnerability only when tied to unauthorized bytes/effects or an evidenced resource-budget failure. Keep distinct resolver root causes in separate reports.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply the relevant object/field/function policy at the resolver or shared data boundary; ensure loaders and caches retain actor/tenant isolation. Retest the original path, another path to the same node and an entitled query.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
